sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Corporate Perks is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello, mercenary. Before all the chaos happened in the city, there was this Russian software company. Can't remember the name anymore, only that they made the best software in their niche. I still use some of their work to this day. It wasn't a large company, which is exactly why I can't understand how they managed to deliver such high-quality software so quickly. They had to be hiding something, and I'd very much like to know what it was. Would you satisfy my curiosity? Find their office and take a look around."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - This quest is only obtainable by BEAR PMCs.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate the IT firm office on Streets of Tarkov
- Unravel the secret of the firm's success
- Survive and extract from the location

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.25
- 165,000 Roubles
  - 173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"A torture room, you say? Very, uh... medieval. But apparently it got results. Well then, here's your payment."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in Raid | Notes |
| "Negotiation" room key | 1 | Required | N/A | Unlocks the negotiation room inside the Zmeisky 6 building on Streets of Tarkov. |
In this quest you first have to find the IT firm office on Streets of Tarkov. The building is located in the Zmeisky alley, house no. 6. Afterwards you have to unravel the secret of the firm's success. To do that, you need to enter the locked "negotiation room" on the south end of the building. A "Negotiation" room key is required to access it.
